summary: Fossil ages and extant/extinct status are openly queryable in PBDB (taxa with first and last appearance in Ma), which supports a taxonomic version of the question (proportion of fossil genera that still have living members, by age). A morphological distance needs character matrices containing fossils and living taxa; MorphoBank was unreachable and the only matrix confirmed here (Lloyd 2018) covers coelurosaurian theropods.
next_step: For a taxonomic test, pull PBDB genera with ages and extant flag; for a morphological test choose clades with open matrices (Dryad/MorphoBank supplements) and pre-register the age-distance regression.
obstacles_confirmed: Matrices are clade-specific; no all-life fossil+extant character matrix was found.
